items.title: OpenAI data center chief exits as 4 executives leave ahead of 2027 IPO
items.summary: Malone joined OpenAI in March 2025, shortly after the company unveiled Stargate — a joint venture with Oracle and SoftBank to build AI data-center capacity at scale. His exit follows the departures of Chief Revenue Officer Denise Dresser, Chief Operating Officer Brad Lightcap, and Fidji Simo, who served as second-in-command to CEO Sam Altman, according to the WSJ report. Analysts have noted that clustering this many C-suite exits in the months before a listing is unusual even by pre-IPO standard
